description_en: Queries the list of created image-to-text search application instances
description_zh: 调用该接口，查询已创建的以图搜图应用实例列表
name: QueryPictureSearchApps

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 50. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量。最大取值50，最小取值1，默认取值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying from in the response. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.
200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

PageData.description_en: The list of image-to-text search application instances
PageData.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例列表

AppInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the image-to-text search application

AppTemplateId.description_en: The template ID of the image-to-text search application instance
AppTemplateId.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例模板ID

CreateTime.description_en: The 13-digit timestamp when the image-to-text search application instance was created, in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建以图搜图应用实例的13位时间戳，单位为毫秒

Description.description_en: The description of the image-to-text search application instance
Description.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例的描述信息

ModifiedTime.description_en: The 13-digit timestamp when the image-to-text search application instance was modified, in milliseconds
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改以图搜图应用实例的13位时间戳，单位为毫秒

Name.description_en: The name of the image-to-text search application instance
Name.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例的名称

Version.description_en: The version number of the image-to-text search application instance template
Version.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例模板的版本号

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the response
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量

Total.description_en: The total number of created image-to-text search application instances
Total.description_zh: 已创建的以图搜图应用实例总数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Specified parameter CurrentPage is not valid.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
